Name: Mineral Drinks
Author: o0MrPro
Description:
[left][color=#ffe599]This mod is compatible with SV 1.6+ you need the latest update of the required mods and their requirements!
[/color]
Do you feel like mining is boring or profitless and not worth the trip in the end game?
Do you feel like artifacts are just trash after donating all of them to the Musume?
This mod will allow you to use your excess artifacts and minerals to create wines and make extra money!

⧗....
⧗...
⧗..

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]❍ What Does This Mod Do? [/size][size=4]
[/size][/font][/left]﻿
- Adds 87 new wines to the game, each with new sprite and lore-friendly item descriptions.
- You can age them in casks, they take 56 days to reach iridium like other vanilla wines.
- Most drinks will reduce speed by 1 like other vanilla wines; some have more unique buffs.
- The prices are calculated the same way as vanilla wines (3 × Base Sell Price)
- What can be kegged:
1. all [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Minerals]minerals[/url]. (1 item per wine; 7~ days to produce)﻿﻿
2. all [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Artifacts]artifacts[/url]﻿ except the ones which can be milled. (1 item per wine; 7~ days to produce)
3. Radioactive bar, Iridium bar, Gold bar, Iron bar, Copper bar. (5 bars per wine; 14~ days to produce)

[b]*NEW*[/b]
I included a second version of the mod where all minerals and artifacts turn into one object "Suspicious Wine". This version aims to make it easier to ship the wines all at once and not have to ship each one individually to achieve the trophy of shipping all items.
- Thanks to Kyrara2015 for the suggestion.

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]❍ Gifting to villagers [/size]
[/font]
- Most of the wines are liked by rock/weird stuff lovers like Abigail, Dwarf, Clint, Krobus, and sometimes Harvey and Emily
- When it comes to gifting artifacts the mod gets a bit creative so you might have to guess who would like to drink that wine.
- This mod also keeps in mind the gift taste of each mineral and matches it with its wine
- e.g. all villagers love prismatic shard except Haley = all villagers love prismatic wine except Haley, etc.
[left]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]❍ Installation 
[/font]
[/size][/left][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2642]Custom Cask Mod[/url]﻿ along with their requirements.
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFMAutomate[/url]﻿ if you are planning to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿ with this mod (recommended).
[*]Download Mineral Drinks OR  Mineral Drinks [S].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]❍ Updating
[/size][/font]
[list=1]
[*]Remove any old Mineral Drinks folders you have in your mods folder before updating.
[*]Install the new version with the installation instructions above.
[/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]❍ How to change prices or disable some items?
[/size][/font]
- to change prices/buffs or other properties you will have to manually edit each object inside Mineral Drinks\[JA] Mineral Drinks.
- to disable items from being keg-able go to Mineral Drinks\[PFM] Mineral Drinks\ProducerRules.json and put /* ...... */ between the things you want to disable
- if you need help disabling something let me know in the comments and I'd be happy to help!

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]❍ Suggestions

[/size][/font]if you have any questions or feature requests please leave a post in the comment section.
you can also check my other mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/90125158?tab=user+files]here[/url]. Have fun!
